newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes marginally down at 14.41 ringgit.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes marginally down at 14.41 ringgit.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia closed three cents lower at 14.41 ringgit ($5.80) a kg on lack of European demand despite a steady London Metal Exchange.

"Europeans were not in the market. That's why the market eased slightly," a trader said, adding that prices were expected to hold at current levels. An initial high offering of 63 tonnes, against a bid of 28, also caused the price fall.
Turnover was 53 tonnes against Thursday's 80 with interest only seen from Japan and Malaysia. The local price differential to London narrowed to $20 a tonne premium from $45 on Thursday.
